title: Pointwise mutual information bounded by stochastic Fisher information
summary: How much information about an unknown parameter can be assigned to one realized outcome, and how is that information constrained by the sensitivity of the same outcome? We derive upper bounds on the pointwise mutual information in terms of the stochastic Fisher information, both for parameters in a bounded interval and for sufficiently regular differentiable priors, and state the corresponding saturation conditions.
